  [critical] /tmp/agentos-D-uKftFI/src/text.js:15 - The regex group size changed from `\d{3}` to `\d{2}`, so thousands separators are placed every two digits instead of three. `formatRupiah(1500000)` returns `"Rp 1.50.00.00"` (the code's own comment expects `"Rp 1.500.000"`), and `formatRupiah(999)` returns `"Rp 9.99"` (the test expects `"Rp 999"`). Any price shown on the sample company profile page would be displayed wrong, e.g. a 12,345,678 price shows as "Rp 12.34.56.78". - Revert the quantifier to `\d{3}`, i.e. `/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g`, which is the form the test and comment require.
